The grand wedding of Bihar politician Anant Singh's daughter, Shivangi Singh, has grabbed international attention. From the BBC and Al Jazeera to CNN, The Guardian, AFP and other international media outlets, the wedding has become a major talking point across the world.
But what exactly are international media outlets writing about this wedding?
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
